core_obligations: Statement (lines 6041-6051): if a : U -> X gives a proper hypercovering of X by the simplicial object U of LC, then K -> Ra_*(a^{-1}K) is an isomorphism for all K in D^+(X), where a : Sh(U_Zar) -> Sh(X) is the augmentation.

Setup (proof lines 6053-6061): consider the diagram of Lemma lemma-compare-simplicial-objects; Rh_{n,*}h_n^{-1} = id on D^+(U_n) by the Cohomology on Sites lemma, hence Rh_*h^{-1} = id on D^+(U_Zar) by the simplicial direct-image lemma.

Four-equality chain (lines 6063-6082): Ra_*(a^{-1}K) = Ra_*Rh_*h^{-1}a^{-1}K = Rh_{-1,*}Ra_{qc,*}a_{qc}^{-1}(h_{-1})^{-1}K (commutativity of the comparison diagram) = Rh_{-1,*}(h_{-1})^{-1}K (descent lemma; U is a hypercovering in LC_qc by the proper-surjective lemma) = K.

Collapse by qc-hypercovering descent and conclude.
